landing.tagline: ✨ The smartest way to organize your draw
landing.description: Forget about paper slips. Add your friends, set exclusion rules, and let the system notify everyone via Email or WhatsApp instantly.
landing.features_subtitle: A simple, fast, and 100% cheat-free process.
landing.f1_desc: Add your friends, family, or coworkers. As many as you want!
landing.f2_desc: John can't give a gift to Mary? Easily configure rules to avoid unwanted matches.
landing.f3_desc: Our algorithm handles everything. No one will know who they got until they receive the message.
landing.f4_desc: Send the results magically via Email, WhatsApp, or SMS.
